note: Numbers only. No verdict is recorded here; the owner records it in spec/evals.md §7.
grouping_note: M0 has one family (BB), so there is no family-holdout split: the headline here is leave-one-program-out over the construction programs, not the family-holdout metric INV-2 names as the headline. Each program is held out once; metrics are computed on the pooled out-of-fold predictions.

model.target: log10(true_ler) on non-censored rows only (INV-3); censored rows are predicted and ranked

scores.truth: ascending true_ler, or true_ler_ub if censored (D-035)

bootstrap.interval: percentile 95% (2.5th, 97.5th), paired over model and phi

recall_ties: expected recall under uniformly random tie-breaking at both cut-offs

label_noise_ceiling.draw: per code, P_L ~ Beta(failures + 0.5, shots - failures + 0.5), censored rows included; LER = logical_error_rate(P_L, rounds, k)
label_noise_ceiling.truth: each draw's top 10 by drawn LER
label_noise_ceiling.scorer: the observed ranking: true_ler, or true_ler_ub if censored (D-035); same tie rule
